tasks.subject: Task 7: Rewrite build_extract_tasks.py for grouped + standard branches
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: backend/analytics/management/commands/build_extract_tasks.py
- Test: backend/analytics/tests/test_build_extract_tasks.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] standard dataset produces one ExtractTask per (feature, resource, po), resource_ids=[resource.id]
- [ ] grouped dataset produces one ExtractTask per (feature, period-bucket, po), resource_ids sorted ascending containing every resource in the bucket
- [ ] claiming prevents duplicate concurrent builds of the same pair
- [ ] dataset_id and task_group_period populated on every inserted row

**Verify:** cd backend && /app/.venv/bin/python manage.py test analytics.tests.test_build_extract_tasks -v 2

tasks.subject: Task 8: Rewrite run_extract_task for resource_ids + partial retry
tasks.description:
**Goal:** _run_extract_task loops over task.resource_ids, runs the processor once per resource, writes position-aligned ExtractData arrays, skips already-filled positions on rerun, leaves failed positions NULL instead of failing the whole task.

**Files:**
- Modify: backend/analytics/tasks/processing.py
- Test: backend/analytics/tests/test_processing.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] standard task (1-element resource_ids) behaves identically to pre-redesign
- [ ] grouped task reads every resource in order, writes position-aligned values
- [ ] one resource's failure leaves NULL at that position without failing the task or other positions
- [ ] rerun only reprocesses NULL positions

**Verify:** cd backend && /app/.venv/bin/python manage.py test analytics.tests.test_processing -v 2

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/analytics/tasks/processing.py", "backend/analytics/tests/test_processing.py"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && /app/.venv/bin/python manage.py test analytics.tests.test_processing -v 2", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all-success case produces full arrays and status=1", "partial failure leaves NULL and non-complete status", "rerun only touches NULL positions"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
